0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Nesh Ohr has something to ask you.

24.original: Lie in wait at the designated location and defeat the father of armored dragons.

48.original: Come closer, little one. I must ask thee─did a pitiable dragonet meet its end at thy hand?

52.original: Though I cannot find it in my heart to thank thee, nor shall I admonish thee. The young one would have suffered every living moment...as do we all, though some torments are more easily borne.

53.original: If thou wouldst prevent further needless suffering, pray seek my shelled kin at the shallow lake. He hath wallowed overlong in hatred beyond healing.

54.original: Wait by the waterside, and he will find thee.

56.original: ...So it is done. I heard his dying cry.

57.original: His bloodline was the strongest of the armored ones, possessed of carapaces like unto stone. Yet even they were not impervious to the metal fiends' onslaught.

58.original: It took but one to raze their nest. Even now, its terrible form doth linger in my mind─the four jaws that ravened 'neath a shroud of steel...

59.original: And to the few who escaped the carnage, life has gifted naught but despair. They yearn for vengeance, though our enemy has long since quit this place.

60.original: As thou hast witnessed, they now turn all too quickly to indiscriminate violence... Alas, this only feedeth the fires of their guilt─never doth it quell them.

61.original: Nay, I fear that only death hath that power.
